title: Camellia and Velvet Korma
description: A creamy and aromatic Indian-inspired korma made with camellia oil and velvet texture.
instructions: Heat the camellia oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the garam masala, cumin powder, and coriander powder and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the chopped velvet and sauté for 2-3 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let it cook for 10-12 minutes or until the velvet is tender.
Serve hot garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
